10.content: - When rating moves, boost scores for moves that reduce the Manhattan distance to the G (goal) position, prioritizing progress toward the goal, but reduce boost or penalize if the move gets the agent closer to H (hazards) without an immediate safe escape route. Rate moves that lead directly into H (hazards) with the lowest possible score, near zero or negative, to strongly avoid termination.

11.content: - Prefer moves into open F cells over other types, assigning higher scores to moves landing on F compared to occupied or unknown cells, especially when they enable pivots away from nearby hazards. In lookahead ratings, penalize moves that corner the agent near multiple H cells, reducing future movement options, even if the immediate cell is F.
